All 12 PASS (1.33s, 100%): (1) POST /reputation/recompute returns {message:'Recomputed', domain_count: N>=3} and persists per-(user,domain) docs with score_30d/score_7d/inbox_count/inboxes[]; (2) GET /reputation returns correct shape (domains[], summary{avg_score_30d, avg_score_7d, total_domains, buckets, worst, best}, stale, cache_ttl_hours=24) with valid bucket labels (excellent|good|fair|poor|critical) on every domain row + bucket_30d/bucket_7d; (3) Zero-send inbox score lands at ~39 (matches the formula 0.5*0 + 0.1*age(33) + 0.1*60(warmup_off) + 0.2*100 + 0.05*100 + 0.05*100 ≈ 39 — asserted in 25-55 range, with bounce/error/unsub components ==100 confirmed); (4) Bounced inbox (5 bounced + 5 sent seeded in email_queue) → bounce_score clamped to 0, bounce_rate >= 40% — penalty kicks in correctly; (5) GET /issues returns counts + paused/risky/errored arrays; seeded paused appears in paused[], disconnected (with last_error) appears in errored[] OR risky[]; total = paused+risky+errored; (6) bulk action='invalid' → 400; (7) account_ids=[] → 422 (Pydantic min_length=1); (8) Unknown account_id → 404 'No matching inboxes'; (9) bulk='resume' flips DB to status='connected', paused=false, last_error=null; (10) bulk='pause' flips to status='paused', paused=true; (11) bulk='delete' removes account row AND $pulls from campaigns.account_ids + drip_campaigns.account_ids (verified other_account_id preserved); (12) bulk='replace' on disconnected → logs row in tracked_replacements with triggered_by='manual', status in (completed|no_candidate). Bulk buttons disabled when nothing selected; after issues-select-all click, '2 selected' shown and buttons enabled. Clicking issues-bulk-resume POSTed bulk action=resume and toast 'resume: 2 succeeded' appeared; counts went to 0 and 'Everything looks healthy' empty state shown. (d) Regression — Forecast, Domain Tracking (Reputation column header present, but no dom-rep-<domain> cells visible because the Domain Tracking & Expiry section had 0 tracked domains in this workspace — the column renders inside Domain Capacity rows, expected behavior), Auto-Allocator, Capacity Planner, ReplacementSection all still render. issues-preview-list element is conditionally rendered only when issues exist (zero issues currently, so absent on first /infrastructure load) — by design. All seed data + session tokens cleaned up post-run.

integration_issues.issue: issues-preview-list element only renders when counts.total > 0. On a clean workspace (no paused/risky/errored inboxes) the element is absent and the empty-state 'Everything looks healthy.' is shown instead — correct by design but worth flagging if the spec demands the element always exists.

dom-rep-<domain> cells only render inside Domain Capacity (Domain Tracking) rows when there are domains in that table. The Reputation Average card already shows the per-domain reputation summary, and the table column appears once domains are tracked. Not blocking.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' / '<span> cannot be child of <tbody>' (emergent visual-editor span wrapper around table rows). Carried since iter-48, NOT introduced by Phase C.

action_items: Phase C ships clean — no functional defects. The reputation cache, recompute endpoint, formula weights, issues dashboard, and all 4 bulk actions (resume/pause/replace/delete) are functionally correct on backend and UI.

Optional polish: if the spec demands issues-preview-list always exists, render it as an always-present empty <ul data-testid='issues-preview-list'/> even when zero issues. Currently it's gated behind a conditional.

Carry-over from iter-57: Infrastructure.jsx file size (~2580 → ~2900 LOC after Phase C inline) — split into /pages/infrastructure/{Forecast,DomainTracking,Allocator,Planner,Replacements,Reputation,Issues}.jsx is still recommended.
critical_code_review_comments: infra_phase_c.py is a clean 522-line single-file module. WEIGHTS dict at top matches the user-confirmed spec (reply 50%, age 10%, warmup 10%, bounce 20%, unsub 5%, error 5%). All weights sum to 1.00.

_score_from_counts handles zero-sends correctly: if real_sends == 0, all RATE components reduce to 0 (so bounce_score / error_score / unsub_score collapse to clamp(100-0)=100). This means a brand-new inbox is treated as clean, not as 'no data → penalize'. Reasonable.
_warmup_component scoring: warmup_off=60, active/complete=100, warming/in_progress=50, off-and-set=30. Matches spec.
_compute_reputation_for_user groups inboxes per (user_id, domain) — super_admin scan correctly creates per-tenant rows so role-scoped reads stay accurate. Good.

Cache strategy: GET /reputation checks oldest computed_at; if > 24h OR cache empty, schedules asyncio.create_task(_compute_reputation_for_user) and returns current cache + stale=true. Non-blocking. Good.
POST /reputation/recompute is synchronous — matches spec for force recompute.
Bulk delete uses $pull to remove the account_id from BOTH campaigns.account_ids AND drip_campaigns.account_ids before deleting the email_accounts row. Tested + verified.

Bulk replace re-implements the Phase B candidate picker inline (free + cross-domain first, then -remaining_capacity, then -daily_limit). Logs no_candidate to tracked_replacements when no pool. Good — keeps Phase C independent and avoids double-execution as warned by main agent.

Pydantic BulkIssueAction enforces min_length=1, max_length=500 on account_ids — correctly returns 422 on empty array. Action enum is checked manually inside the handler (raises 400 if not in resume|pause|replace|delete). Could be tightened by using Literal['resume','pause','replace','delete'] for fastapi to return 422 instead of 400, but current behavior matches the spec ('action=invalid returns 400').
Minor: WEIGHTS sum is exactly 1.00 (0.5+0.1+0.1+0.2+0.05+0.05). Good.
Minor: _gather_window_counts uses ISO string comparison on sent_at — works because all writes are ISO with UTC suffix; do NOT mix with naive datetime objects.
